description: Review Terraform, CloudFormation, or Kubernetes files against cited cloud best practices. Pass the file contents. Without an API key it returns the top 3 findings by severity plus counts for the rest. With KHAVION_API_KEY set in the server's environment and valid, it returns every finding, the quote total, the recommended next step, and a report link. File contents stay on this machine; only the key, rule ids, and a count of services are sent to Khavion.

content.description: The full text of the file.

path.description: File path, used for labels and to spot .tf files.

title: Review infrastructure as code
